synergies.name: Tar Carries Rot
synergies.description: Ichor and rot get along. Taint seeded in a Tarred enemy may thicken the tar a layer, setting it fast sooner; a wing torn loose by Wingrend may carry two of your afflictions into whatever it bursts on. Each level adds 4% to these odds.

synergies.name: Bad Blood
synergies.description: Your blood has gone bad, and theirs goes with it. Pass It On while your own vein is open may leave the target bleeding your blood, a Weeping Cut two deep; hits on an enemy that is both Tainted and under Vein Pressure may push its pressure a notch, the rot thickening its blood toward rupture. Each level adds 4% to these odds.

synergies.name: Rotted Sight
synergies.description: Rot reaches the eyes first. Taint seeded in a Benighted enemy may blind it outright; a Tainted enemy that dies may pass black fire to the next host along with its rot, leaving it Smouldering. Each level adds 4% to these odds.

synergies.name: Carried Curse
synergies.description: The relic's Mark rides the rot. A Marked, Tainted enemy that dies may pass the Mark to the next host; your spells on a Marked enemy may hand it one of your afflictions as well. Each level adds 4% to these odds.
